title: Frozen dimension-state-closure-fidelity-cost synthesis
question: Given the already frozen Layer-ROM fidelity frontier, what computational reduction is actually observed for L4, L6 and R8, without changing representation or fidelity acceptance after timing results are seen?
synthesis_vector: state-information interpretation inherited from Phase A/B
fixed-flux propagation interpretation inherited from Phase A
fixed-head continuous-time groundwater fidelity inherited from Phase B
same-partition Layer-ROM versus CoRichards groundwater relation inherited from B1HCP
FINE/BASE temporal-refinement cost factor per material
resolved-cheaper flags under the frozen paired two-SE rule

adjudication.cost_screen_complete: Only if COST1 completes all six materials and all ten routes under its frozen equivalence and timing gates.
adjudication.computational_reduction_signal_vs_R16: Use COST1 robust_reduction_signal_vs_R16 exactly: both BASE and FINE resolved cheaper than R16 on all six materials for that dimension.
adjudication.same_partition_cost_signal: Report BASE and FINE resolved-cheaper counts and per-material relations versus same-partition CoRichards; do not convert this to a scalar winner.
adjudication.fidelity_relation: Carry B1HCP relation labels unchanged. Timing may not alter COR_COMPONENTWISE_NO_WORSE, LAYER_ROM_COMPONENTWISE_NO_WORSE or TRADEOFF labels.
adjudication.practical_interpretation: A dimension can be described as having a shared-host computational reduction signal only if the relevant frozen COST1 rule is satisfied. This remains separate from hydrological application acceptance.
adjudication.no_universal_minimum: Cost cannot establish a universal minimum dimension because Phase B already found material- and purpose-dependent fidelity.

forbidden: dropping B05 or any other material
selecting a new partition from timing results
changing closure or timestep science because a route is slow
next_rule: If COST1 is incomplete, close CF1 blocked on COST1 and do not infer cost.
If COST1 completes, persist the full multidimensional curve and a bounded research decision on whether further Layer-ROM work is justified.
Any later application-envelope study requires externally sourced purpose tolerances and separate preregistration.
